<function name="SetPos" parent="ProjectedTexture" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Move the Projected Texture to the specified position.

You must call <page>ProjectedTexture:Update</page> after using this function for it to take effect.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="position" type="Vector"></arg>
	</args>
</function>
